authorization.source: Start the approved V1–V8 plan locally on my Windows/vMix computer, using latest main and active mode. Preserve the configured Codex model and effort. Continue until the approved scope is complete. I explicitly authorize untilComplete and automatic blockRenewal. Do not ask for an artificial completion deadline. Choose any required finite planning reference internally; it is not a stop condition or promised finish date. Keep normal bounded work blocks, pause/failure rules, repair limits and permission safeguards.
authorization.scope: Execute only approved vMix V1 through V8 sequentially on local Windows/vMix. Preserve existing CasparCG behavior. NoaCG never drives vMix Program, Preview or transitions. Required Bridge releases and real-vMix evidence remain in scope.
authorization.permissionPolicy: Codex desktop local Windows, workspace-write with managed read restrictions; network and Git metadata writes via scoped require_escalated calls and automatic review. Fresh subagents inherit the configured model, effort, and effective permissions. No unattended wake.

standing.untilComplete: Continue until the approved scope is complete. I explicitly authorize untilComplete and automatic blockRenewal.
standing.blockRenewal: I explicitly authorize untilComplete and automatic blockRenewal.

decisions: AC-6: Each of V2, V5, V6 and V7 must publish the Windows Bridge exe from its landed commit under its own accepted Bridge version, with operator release notes at the top of cli/BRIDGE_CHANGELOG.md and incremental docs/BRIDGE.md coverage. Use the current independent cli/package.json bridgeVersion and release-bridge.yml procedure in docs/BRIDGE.md, preserving CLI version, lockfile, npm publication and CLI changelog. Choose the next appropriate Bridge version from main and published Bridge releases at that phase. V2 notes account for all vMix Bridge changes since Bridge 0.9.0, citing earlier published notes for prior changes where applicable. Verify the exact-merge release and download asset before PASS. While the #1967 hold applies, keep these phases outside the queue and wait for the CI/CD coordinator’s posted release of the hold.
Internal planning reference is actual start plus 14 days; standing untilComplete controls. Work blocks stay finite.
constraints: Never operate or close an operator vMix process. Before each real check, confirm vMix GUI idle; use an owned blank session, back up and verify restoration of last.vmix and user.config, terminate only the owned process and leave vMixService alone. Read Program snapshots only; NoaCG does not command Program, Preview or transitions. Preserve CasparCG. Separate worktrees, reserved ports and owned services, and use the existing single local browser queue. Recheck live write allocations before each phase and landing, including documents. Read #1967 and phase-cf13 section 7.4 before each queue operation and run sideEnds on the actual PR changed file paths; wait if ends.m1 includes cap+cfg under the active hold. No CI/workflow/selector/runner/budget/retry/quarantine changes and no optional benchmarks/full-suite dispatches. Never cancel/rerun another run’s jobs. Retain exact-merge checks and release acceptance. Preserve configured model, effort and permissions.
verification: Two coordinator and two worker preflights passed subprocess/workspace, Git main and Actions reads. Fresh same-host agent result returned in active mode. No model or effort override and no unattended wake claim.

vMix 29.0.0.49 Trial, two blank inputs, idle outputs, via read-only TCP XML. Owned process exited; original last.vmix and user.config restored and verified by SHA-256. vMix background service untouched. ffmpeg and ffprobe version 2025-03-17-git-5b9356f18e-essentials_build ran.
evidence: Existing run and branches reconciled before launch; no active vmix project from supervisor continue.
CI/CD #1967 extended hold, #2261 changed files checked, and codebase-health #2285 P3 document allocations checked.
packet.nextAction: Admit only V1 through the supervisor.
